name: EPIC 210411525
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 10.7 solar radii and 1.30 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210411525 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.744822 (16th-84th percentiles 10.61964-10.89066), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210411525 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.302894 (16th-84th percentiles 1.252474-1.360962), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210411525: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4839.776 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210411525 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1502.109375 (16th-84th percentiles 1487.558594-1517.773438), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.95 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 1,502 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.30 solar masses and 10.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,840 K at its surface.
